description: A board of your agents in columns by status (needs you, working, waiting, done, idle), with the bar and the panels of the kanban layout. The gear menu sets the order of the panel buttons and hides the ones you do not use.

settings.label: Column width
settings.hint: The widest a column may be. Auto: the columns share the board.

settings.label: Stack columns
settings.hint: Waiting under Working and Idle under Done, with smaller heads and cards. Auto stacks below 220 px of board per visible column.

settings.label: Cards
settings.hint: Auto shows summary cards while the columns are stacked.

settings.label: Bar
settings.hint: Icons or names on the bar buttons. Auto shows icons below 1800 px of bar width and all names from 2250 px. Shared by the Kanban bar and the Dock bar.

settings.label: Where panels open
settings.hint: Auto opens a panel at the side when the window is wide, else in a dialog. Shared by the Kanban bar and the Dock bar.

settings.label: Waiting column
settings.hint: A column for the Claude Code agents that wait for their subagents.
